comments.author: Jean
comments.body:
Give Bolero and Bata de Cola.

This map is a reward from completing 8 stars quest "Investigation of Koxinga" .

comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body: I have tried this map today only to find that it drops Bolero only. Back in GAMA I was able to receive both Bolero and Bata de Cola. I have submitted a ticket about it and hopefully I can get it resolved.

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: Yes, I remember my mates and I did this map long ago on GAMA, and each of us came away with a Bolero and a Bata de Cola. I seem to recall the map was a one-time only drop from the quest, so that's quite a sad bug to have run into for those wanting the pink Bata dress. But maybe I remember wrongly?

comments.author: Black_Soul
comments.body: Got both of them but only in 1 toon seems it got nerfed.

comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body: Papaya's response to it was that the second item is not always a guarantee. I am still skeptical of that, but that is their official response to that. If that is true I was seriously unlucky to have it all "fail" on 3 toons.

comments.author: Donce
comments.body: out of 3 maps i got 3 Bolero's and 2 Bata's de Cola
